name: Koutammakou, the Land of the Batammariba
description: Koutammakou is a farming landscape straddling northeastern Togo and neighbouring Benin, home to the Batammariba people. Its signature sight is the mud tower-houses called takienta, often two storeys high, clustered in villages among fields and forest. Springs, sacred rocks and initiation grounds are woven between the homes, so the whole countryside feels like a living ritual map.
